newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares, property still seen as highest-yielding.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares, property still seen as highest-yielding.

text.p: Investment managers expect somewhat lower returns from New Zealand equities, cash and fixed interest in the current year than they did last October, a survey published on Friday showed.
The Alexander Consulting Group Ltd's January Investment Forecasts survey canvassed 12 investment firms.
It asked for their estimate of the annual rate of investment return, before tax and expenses, a New Zealand dollar investor could earn from each investment sector in the year to December 31, 1997.
New Zealand equities and property are still seen as offering the best returns. However, the return from equities is now seen at 12.8 percent, down from 13.5 percent at the time of the last survey.
The return from NZ fixed interest is picked at 7.1 percent, down from 9.6 percent in October and 12.2 percent in Alexander's July 1996 survey.
